verdict.rationale: The only AI-related capability documented is 'AI-powered creation of meeting minutes,' which is AI document generation for record keeping, not AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. The custom license summary and compliance notifications are not described as AI-driven, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
